S.FORM: alang Knlibu ga niya mki sku Karing Keng atu Syurin go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 326 buwan, 1,044 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 62% kyan ku 648 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 38% kyan ku 396 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Truku 52%, Amis 4%, Tayan 3%, binah lihuyan s'uli 2%. maki qu ngasal bziran, ngasal psatu tegami ru pqniqan iyu. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Knlibu hya' ga bsilung. tay 'zil na Knlibu hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkyahu' na Knlibu hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkraya' na Knlibu hya' ga llyung. tay mkyahu' na Knlibu hya' ga Gukut. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy maki 1 pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy. pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ knliβu ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku kariŋ keŋ atu [s|ɕ]jurin ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan **** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa truku ** ami[s|ɕ] * tajan * βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran ŋa[s|ɕ]al p[s|ɕ]atu teɣami ru pqniqan iju rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na knliβu ħjaʔ ɣa β[s|ɕ]iluŋ taj ʔzil na knliβu ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkjaħuʔ na knliβu ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkrajaʔ na knliβu ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkjaħuʔ na knliβu ħjaʔ ɣa ɣukut reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj maki * pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
